signature: MACHT ICH JACOB BAVER NVRMBERG M DCVII
remarks: Flat slide stays, hinged, with dragon-head clasps. Ring in slide bow. Ferrules have dragon-scale pattern in center field. Flat bell stay, richly engraved. Restored by Gary Stewart. Prior to Stewart’s restoration, the instrument was in pieces, with many old soft-solder repairs. Part of bell missing.
